item.title: Hungarian man in Toronto arrested for stealing huge amount of copper cables

item.title: TikTok now warns users of Hungarian government-related content
item.description: TikTok has applied a new warning label to a wide range of Hungarian media outlets and organisations closely linked to the governing Fidesz party. This is the first notable intervention by a global platform.

item.description: Hungary and Europe will experience an exceptional cold wave this weekend. From Mother Russia, with love.
